Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2601.09032v1. Corecraft rubric evaluation and qualitative hierarchy/future quantitative work establish a distinct study. It is not merged with the later training paper or counted as another Corecraft family. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The authors identify systematic quantitative failure-distribution analysis, task-category breakdowns, cross-domain evaluation and benchmark-to-production validation as future work; the proposed hierarchy is therefore not a quantified causal model of deployment performance.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The paper reports GPT-5.2 completion of 61% compared with 57% for GPT-5 in its December 2025 update; even the strongest evaluated system fails approximately 40% of the study’s tasks.
